next.reason: 2023 restates the timing and naming: 'The declarative is invoked just before the named report group is produced during the execution of the runtime element. The report group is named by identifier-1 in the USE BEFORE REPORTING statement' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR8); §2023:14.9.49.4 GR9 lists the same invocation points that 1985 left to its TYPE clause. No 2023 rule bars declaratives in contained source elements, so the nesting permission stands. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR4 orders selection for exception conditions only and does not state this rule. Same effect.
